reason: I already screenshot every K PLUS, BBL and TTB slip and dump them in one place, so a tool that reads them for me saves a real chore. I would only keep it if it actually saves me time after the trial.
objection: My bank app already shows my history, and I doubt the phone text reading will get my K PLUS slips right without me fixing them by hand, which would defeat the point.
would_change_my_mind: If the Shortcut setup took me a few minutes and it correctly saved the amounts and recipients from my own slips during the free 14 days.
